## {{< iconify openmoji japanese-symbol-for-beginner >}} Introduction


## Goals

At the end of this Lab session, we should:

- Understand the concept of a  *contour map*
- Use`raster` form data to construct contour maps with them
- Use the `tanaka` package and appreciate the [Tanaka Method](https://landscapearchaeology.org/2018/tanaka-contour-lines/)
- And of course, add our own data to the contour maps made with `tanaka`


## {{< iconify noto-v1 package >}} Setting up R Packages



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Plotting Maps
library(tidyverse) # Maps using ggplot() + geom_sf()
library(ggformula) # Maps using gf_sf()
# For Spatial Data Frame Processing
library(sf)
library(sfheaders) # Handcrafted Map data
# library(terra)
library(tidyterra) # tidy syntax for terra operations + plotting
library(stars)
## Plotting
library(tanaka)
# Spatial Data
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
# Run this in your console first
# devtools::install_github("ropensci/rnaturalearthhires")
library(rnaturalearthhires)
```
:::
